title: The Weatherlight Mission to Rath
summary: Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew confront Volrath to rescue Captain Sisay.
narrative: Sisay’s capture brought Gerrard back into the life of the Weatherlight crew and into the struggle surrounding the Legacy.
The expedition to Rath exposed the companions to Phyrexian influence, personal betrayals, and the dangerous rule of Volrath.
